title: OpenType Features, Glyph Browser & Text Styles Hierarchy
subtitle: Ligatures, Stylistic Alternates, Swashes & Paragraph/Character Styles

learningObjectives: Navigate the Typography Studio (View > Studio > Typography) to unlock advanced OpenType font capabilities.
Activate and manage Standard Ligatures, Discretionary Ligatures, Contextual Alternates, and Swash flourishes.
Explore the Glyphs Studio to search, filter, and insert rare Unicode symbols, currency marks, and alternate glyph variants.
Build a scalable, reusable Text Style hierarchy (H1 Headline, H2 Subhead, Body Copy, Label) in the Text Styles Studio.
Understand character-level style overrides versus paragraph-level structural formatting.
standardSections.foundationalKnowledge: Modern professional typography is powered by the OpenType specification, which allows a single font file to contain thousands of alternate glyph shapes, ornamental swashes, fraction equations, and ligature connections beyond basic ASCII characters. In Affinity Designer, the Typography Studio exposes the full depth of OpenType features. You can enable 'Standard Ligatures' (fusing awkward letter collisions like 'fi', 'fl', and 'ffi' into single artistic glyphs), toggle 'Discretionary Ligatures' (historical connections like 'st' and 'ct'), and access 'Stylistic Sets' designed by the type foundry. Furthermore, the Text Styles Studio allows you to save and broadcast typography changes across an entire multi-screen vector project in one click.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Open the Typography Studio
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Go to View > Studio > Typography. Notice the panel reveals categories for Ligatures, Stylistic Sets, Letter Case, Figures, and Positional Forms.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Enable Standard and Discretionary Ligatures
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Type the word 'Affinity Craftsmanship' using a quality serif font (e.g. Adobe Caslon, Baskerville, or Playfair Display). In the Typography Studio, verify 'Standard Ligatures' is active. Notice the 'ffi' and 'ft' letters seamlessly fuse together into elegant single glyphs. Toggle 'Discretionary Ligatures' to see vintage connections.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Inspect Variants in the Glyphs Studio
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Go to View > Studio > Glyphs. Highlight the first capital letter 'A' of your word. In the Glyphs Studio, change the filter dropdown to 'Alternates for Selection'. Notice all custom swashes, flourishes, and alternate cuts designed for that exact letter! Double-click a swash glyph to replace the character on canvas.

stepByStepInstructions.title: Create a Global Reusable Text Style
stepByStepInstructions.instruction: Open the Text Styles Studio (View > Studio > Text Styles). Highlight your styled headline. In the panel menu, click 'Create Paragraph Style'. Name it 'Brand_Heading_1'. Now, select any raw text frame on any artboard and click 'Brand_Heading_1'—all font family, weight, tracking, and OpenType settings apply instantly!

commonPitfalls.pitfall: OpenType features button is grayed out or has no effect
commonPitfalls.cause: The active font does not contain OpenType font tables for that feature (many cheap or web-ripped fonts lack ligatures and swashes).
commonPitfalls.solution: Switch to an authentic OpenType font (e.g. Adobe Garamond, Playfair Display, Montserrat, or Cormorant Garamond).

commonPitfalls.pitfall: Accidentally styling whole paragraph when trying to format one word
commonPitfalls.cause: Applying a Paragraph Style instead of a Character Style to a localized selection.
commonPitfalls.solution: Use Paragraph Styles for whole-block formatting (margins, leading); use Character Styles for inline word accents (bold, color, swash).

commonPitfalls.pitfall: Manual overrides overriding global Text Style updates
commonPitfalls.cause: Editing point size manually after applying a text style adds a '+' override badge.
commonPitfalls.solution: Click the 'Clear Overrides' button in the Text Styles panel to re-synchronize the text with its master style definition.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the function of the Glyphs Studio (View > Studio > Glyphs) in Affinity Designer?
options: It searches Google Fonts for new downloads.
It displays every individual glyph, alternate character, punctuation symbol, and swash contained inside the active font file, allowing one-click insertion.
It converts the document into vector outlines.
It checks for grammatical spelling errors.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: The Glyphs Studio provides a comprehensive visual character map of all Unicode and OpenType glyphs embedded inside the current typeface.

knowledgeCheck.question: What is the difference between 'Standard Ligatures' and 'Discretionary Ligatures'?
options: Standard ligatures are free; discretionary ligatures cost money.
Standard ligatures fix physical character collisions for readability (fi, fl, ffi); Discretionary ligatures are decorative or historical joints (st, ct) used for artistic styling.
Standard ligatures only work in English; Discretionary ligatures work in French.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Standard ligatures resolve optical collisions to improve body copy legibility, whereas Discretionary ligatures add stylistic, historical, or vintage flair.

knowledgeCheck.question: Why is utilizing the Text Styles Studio superior to formatting text boxes manually across an enterprise UI design system?
options: It prevents the user from typing words.
Updating a master Text Style (e.g. changing font size from 14pt to 16pt) instantly broadcasts and synchronizes across hundreds of connected text layers in the document.
It automatically translates text into 10 languages.
It compresses the file size to zero bytes.
knowledgeCheck.explanation: Text Styles establish single-source-of-truth design tokens: editing the master style updates all associated typography instances document-wide.

summaryPoints: The Typography Studio exposes OpenType ligatures, swashes, and stylistic sets.
The Glyphs Studio enables browsing and inserting rare characters and glyph variants.
Text Styles (Paragraph & Character) synchronize typography across complex projects.
Clear overrides in the Text Styles Studio re-binds text to master design tokens.

slides.title: OpenType Features, Glyph Browser & Text Styles Hierarchy
slides.subtitle: Unlocking Hidden Font Treasures & Enterprise Style Systems
slides.contentMarkdown:
Welcome to **Lesson D06-03**.

Did you know that top-tier fonts contain thousands of hidden characters, swashes, and alternate letters that never appear on standard keyboards?

In this lesson, you will master the **Typography Studio** and **Glyphs Studio** to unlock OpenType swashes and ligatures, and architect a scalable **Text Style Hierarchy** for design systems.

actionBox.label: Typography Superpower
actionBox.text: Turn ordinary typing into bespoke hand-lettered art using OpenType swashes and alternates.

slides.title: The World of OpenType Features
slides.subtitle: Ligatures, Swashes & Stylistic Sets
slides.contentMarkdown:
Professional OpenType fonts are mini software programs packed with features:

1. **Standard Ligatures (`liga`):** Eliminates collisions where letter dots hit crossbars (e.g. `fi`, `fl`, `ffi`).
2. **Discretionary Ligatures (`dlig`):** Vintage artistic bridges (e.g. `ct`, `st`, `sp`).
3. **Swashes (`swsh`):** Extends calligraphic flourish tails on capital letters.
4. **Stylistic Sets (`ss01-20`):** Alternate letter cuts (e.g. swapping between a geometric circular 'a' and a humanist double-story 'a').

visual.content: Standard Ligatures (fi, fl) | Discretionary (st, ct) | Swashes (Flourishes) | Stylistic Sets

slides.title: The Typography Studio (View > Studio > Typography)
slides.subtitle: Your Control Center for Font Features
slides.contentMarkdown:
Open the panel via `View > Studio > Typography`:

- **Ligatures Section:** Checkboxes to toggle Standard, Discretionary, and Historical ligatures.
- **Stylistic Sets Section:** Browse numbered alternate character sets provided by the font author.
- **Figures Section:** Choose between *Proportional Lining* (modern table numbers) and *Oldstyle Non-Lining* (classic numbers with ascenders and descenders that flow naturally in text).

actionBox.label: Quality Note
actionBox.text: OpenType features require a font that contains them! Quality typefaces (Playfair, Baskerville, Montserrat) shine here.

slides.title: The Glyphs Studio: Visual Character Map
slides.subtitle: Discovering Every Embedded Character
slides.contentMarkdown:
Open the panel via `View > Studio > Glyphs`:

- Displays every single vector glyph embedded in the active font.
- **Filter Dropdown:** Switch to **'Alternates for Selection'** to instantly inspect all available variant drawings for the character highlighted on your canvas!
- **One-Click Insert:** Double-click any glyph in the grid to replace the canvas letter immediately.

Highlight Letter 'A' on Canvas ──► Glyphs Studio Filter: 'Alternates for Selection'

slides.title: Paragraph Styles vs Character Styles
slides.subtitle: The Two Pillars of Text Architecture
slides.contentMarkdown:
In the Text Styles Studio (`View > Studio > Text Styles`):

1. **Paragraph Styles:**
   - Governs the *entire structural paragraph block* (margins, leading, alignment, indents, base font).
   - Examples: `Heading_1`, `Subhead`, `Body_Copy`, `Legal_Footnote`.
2. **Character Styles:**
   - Governs *localized inline character exceptions* (bold emphasis, cyan accent color, swash override).
   - Floats on top of paragraph styles without breaking line leading.

visual.content: Paragraph Style: Formats entire block structure VS Character Style: Formats inline words/accents

slides.title: Step-by-Step: Creating a Master Style
slides.subtitle: Building Design System Typography Tokens
slides.contentMarkdown:
Follow these steps to establish an enterprise typography token:

1. **Step 1:** Format a headline on your artboard: `Playfair Display`, `36 pt`, Bold, tracking `-10‰`.
2. **Step 2:** Open the **Text Styles Studio** (`View > Studio > Text Styles`).
3. **Step 3:** Click the panel menu and choose **'Create Paragraph Style'**.
4. **Step 4:** Name it **'Brand_Display_H1'** and click OK.
5. **Step 5:** Select any text frame across all artboards and click 'Brand_Display_H1'.
6. **The Magic:** If you ever edit 'Brand_Display_H1' in the studio, every headline in your entire project updates instantly!

actionBox.label: Design Token Power
actionBox.text: Text Styles save days of manual updating when brands change their corporate typeface.

slides.title: OpenType & Style Pitfalls
slides.subtitle: Avoid Common Typography Bugs
slides.contentMarkdown:
### 1. The '+' Override Badge Trap
- **The Issue:** A text style displays as `Brand_H1 +` and won't update when the master style changes.
- **The Cause:** Someone manually tweaked point size or color on the canvas after applying the style.
- **The Fix:** In the Text Styles panel, click **'Clear Overrides'** to restore pure master inheritance.

### 2. Discretionary Ligatures in Body Copy
- **The Trap:** Leaving 'ct' and 'st' ligatures active in body paragraphs impairs reading speed.
- **The Fix:** Reserve discretionary ligatures for logos and titles; keep standard ligatures (`fi`, `fl`) for body copy.

visual.content: Clear Overrides to Re-Sync | Discretionary for Titles Only | Standard Ligatures for Body

slides.title: Independent Challenge: Historical Book Title Page
slides.subtitle: Put OpenType & Text Styles to the Test
slides.contentMarkdown:
### Your Mission:
Construct an authentic Victorian literary title page:

1. Book title: Serif typeface with **Discretionary Ligatures** active (fusing 'st' or 'ct').
2. Author name: Incorporate a **Swash capital initial** selected from the **Glyphs Studio**.
3. Volume label: Set in **OpenType Small Caps** (`VOL. I • LONDON 1894`).
4. Establish 3 linked styles in the **Text Styles Studio**: `Book_Title`, `Book_Author`, and `Book_Meta`.

### Acceptance Criteria:
- Discretionary ligatures and swash alternates visible on canvas.
- Glyphs Studio used to choose alternate character cuts.
- 3 formal styles created in Text Styles Studio.
